question.:question/problem:
How can we best describe the following matrix?

$$
A = \begin{bmatrix}1 & 0 & 0 \\ 6 & -6 & 0 \\ 8 & -10 & -7\end{bmatrix}
$$

Choose the most specific listed description: identity before diagonal, and diagonal before upper or lower triangular. Choose Other only if none of these descriptions applies.
question.:question/worked-solution:
Notice that $A$ is a matrix for which all entries above the diagonal are $0$'s:

$$
A = \begin{bmatrix}1 & 0 & 0 \\ 6 & -6 & 0 \\ 8 & -10 & -7\end{bmatrix}
$$

Therefore, it is a lower triangular matrix.

It is not an upper triangular matrix or a diagonal matrix since there is a non-zero element below the diagonal: ${a}_{21}=6\ne 0.$

question.:question/problem:
How can we best describe the following matrix?

$$
A = \begin{bmatrix}0 & -5 & -5 \\ 0 & 0 & -5 \\ 0 & 0 & 0\end{bmatrix}
$$

Choose the most specific listed description: identity before diagonal, and diagonal before upper or lower triangular. Choose Other only if none of these descriptions applies.
question.:question/worked-solution:
Notice that $A$ is a matrix for which all entries below the diagonal are $0$'s:

$$
A = \begin{bmatrix}0 & -5 & -5 \\ 0 & 0 & -5 \\ 0 & 0 & 0\end{bmatrix}
$$

Therefore, it is an upper triangular matrix.

It is not a lower triangular matrix or a diagonal matrix since there is a non-zero element above the diagonal: ${a}_{12}=-5\ne 0.$
